title: 摘樱桃
summary: 从左上到右下再返回左上，路径只能经过非荆棘格，樱桃每格最多摘一次，求最多樱桃数。
insight: 往返可视为两个人同时从左上走到右下；同一时刻两人步数相同，用 (r1,c1,r2) 确定 c2，并对四种下一步组合做 DP。
pitfalls: 两人落在同一格时樱桃只能计一次
任一路径落到荆棘或越界都无效
完全不可达时答案返回零

solutions.title: 同步双路径记忆化搜索
solutions.idea: 把往返路径转换为两条同向路径，并缓存三维状态。
steps: 越界或荆棘返回负无穷，抵达终点返回该格值
当前两格樱桃去重相加，再加四种移动组合最大值；缓存，最终 max(0,dfs(0,0,0))

code.java: class Solution { private int[][] grid;private Integer[][][] memo;private int n;public int cherryPickup(int[][] grid){this.grid=grid;n=grid.length;memo=new Integer[n][n][n];return Math.max(0,dfs(0,0,0));}private int dfs(int r1,int c1,int r2){int c2=r1+c1-r2;if(r1>=n||c1>=n||r2>=n||c2<0||c2>=n||grid[r1][c1]==-1||grid[r2][c2]==-1)return -1000000;if(r1==n-1&&c1==n-1)return grid[r1][c1];if(memo[r1][c1][r2]!=null)return memo[r1][c1][r2];int cherries=grid[r1][c1]+(r1==r2&&c1==c2?0:grid[r2][c2]);int next=Math.max(Math.max(dfs(r1+1,c1,r2+1),dfs(r1+1,c1,r2)),Math.max(dfs(r1,c1+1,r2+1),dfs(r1,c1+1,r2)));return memo[r1][c1][r2]=cherries+next;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private lateinit var grid:Array<IntArray>;private lateinit var memo:Array<Array<Array<Int?>>>;private var n=0;fun cherryPickup(grid:Array<IntArray>):Int{this.grid=grid;n=grid.size;memo=Array(n){Array(n){arrayOfNulls<Int>(n)}};return maxOf(0,dfs(0,0,0))};private fun dfs(r1:Int,c1:Int,r2:Int):Int{val c2=r1+c1-r2;if(r1>=n||c1>=n||r2>=n||c2 !in 0 until n||grid[r1][c1]==-1||grid[r2][c2]==-1)return -1000000;if(r1==n-1&&c1==n-1)return grid[r1][c1];memo[r1][c1][r2]?.let{return it};val cherries=grid[r1][c1]+if(r1==r2&&c1==c2)0 else grid[r2][c2];val next=maxOf(dfs(r1+1,c1,r2+1),dfs(r1+1,c1,r2),dfs(r1,c1+1,r2+1),dfs(r1,c1+1,r2));return(cherries+next).also{memo[r1][c1][r2]=it}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<vector<int>> grid;vector<vector<vector<int>>> memo;int n;int dfs(int r1,int c1,int r2){int c2=r1+c1-r2;if(r1>=n||c1>=n||r2>=n||c2<0||c2>=n||grid[r1][c1]==-1||grid[r2][c2]==-1)return -1000000;if(r1==n-1&&c1==n-1)return grid[r1][c1];int& result=memo[r1][c1][r2];if(result!=INT_MIN)return result;int cherries=grid[r1][c1]+(r1==r2&&c1==c2?0:grid[r2][c2]);int next=max({dfs(r1+1,c1,r2+1),dfs(r1+1,c1,r2),dfs(r1,c1+1,r2+1),dfs(r1,c1+1,r2)});return result=cherries+next;}public:int cherryPickup(vector<vector<int>>& value){grid=value;n=grid.size();memo.assign(n,vector<vector<int>>(n,vector<int>(n,INT_MIN)));return max(0,dfs(0,0,0));} };
